title: SG-2.4 Manifest loader checks references and falls back without crashing
summary: Manifest loader verifies every manifest reference exists, reports missing assets and falls back safely
description: Context: game/src/assets/loaders/manifestLoader.ts has loadManifestFile, which validates the manifest and checks that each asset file exists on disk. It does not check that scene/object asset refs point at manifest ids, and it has no fallback: any missing file makes the whole load fail with ok:false. Desired behavior: every manifest reference is verified, missing assets are reported by id, and the loader returns a usable manifest plus a fallback asset instead of failing or throwing. Why: missing art must degrade gracefully, never crash the game.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene ref that is not a manifest id, when references are checked, then the dangling ref is reported by name.
Given a manifest asset whose file is missing, when loaded with fallback, then the missing asset is reported and the load still returns a manifest without throwing.
Given an unreadable or malformed manifest, when loaded with fallback, then an empty manifest and the error are returned without throwing.

preserve: loadManifestFile behavior and its existing tests

technical_constraints: TypeScript, zod schema already in game/src/assets/manifest
Use node fs only inside the loader, as today
definition_of_done: Both requirements implemented and verified by unit tests
